evidence.quote: Owned intelligence is not the same as rented intelligence.

observations.why: Flat, unhedged declarative stated by the author with no permanence, ratification, or operational-rule language; firm but still a moveable assertion, so claim rather than decision or principle.

evidence.quote: The substrate is a commodity; the perspective is the asset you keep.

observations.why: Plain unhedged assertion with no ratification or permanence markers; the author argues the point rather than settling or declaring it, so claim.
